findings: The four requested content and accounting repairs are present: the runtime interface registry agrees with the four emitted checks, the story asserts only generic one-card-per-space organization, the state order explicitly separates 24 picture labels, 2 story-interface units, 6 sequence checks, 8 direct transfers, and recap without double counting, and the budgets price 36 presentation replay/recheck units, a 388-unit cap, and a 148-unit replay preflight. Rehearsal nevertheless cannot safely unlock because replay control is still contradictory and does not execute the promised no-adaptation epoch. adaptive.controller_transition_table sends closing_recap_fail directly to defer_and_revisit, while runtime_contract.state_machine simultaneously gives closing_recap both score_lt_6_of_8 => defer_and_revisit and aggregate_failure_replay_preflight_pass => presentation_affirmative, with no precedence or mutually exclusive predicate. After that replay transition, the same unguarded presentation-check replay, TRAIN_MORE, PRESENT_AGAIN, and TRAIN_LONGER paths remain reachable even though REPLAY_LESSON.rule says no adaptation during epoch 2. Freeze one deterministic recap disposition and add epoch-2 transition guards that forbid every adaptive action during the 148-unit base-only replay; otherwise a conforming runner can either skip the only legal replay or exceed the frozen replay path.
